newsitem.title: EU: Reuter European Court of Justice Diary for Tuesday, June 10 - Thursday, June 19.
newsitem.headline: Reuter European Court of Justice Diary for Tuesday, June 10 - Thursday, June 19.

text.p: COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-392/95 Parliament v/ Council: approximation of legislation. Annulment of Council regulation 2317/95 of September 25, 1995, determining which third countries' citizens must have a visa upon crossing member states' external borders. Obligation to re-consult the European Parliament under article 100C of the EC treaty following a substantial amendment to the Commission proposal. - Opinion C-391/95 Van Uden: judicial competence convention/execution of decisions. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 5, point 1 and article 24 of the Brussels Convention. Competence to take provisional or protective measures. Interim ruling. Sentencing of a debtor to pay a deposit. Effect of arbitration on the litigation. - Oral procedure C-265/95 Commission v/ France: free movement of goods. Non respect. EC treaty article 30. Failure to have taken all necessary and proportionate measures to prevent individuals from hindering the free movement of fruit and vegetables. - (1100/0900 GMT) Oral procedure C-118/96 Safir: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 6, 59, 60 and 73D. Taxation of savings in the form of life insurance. Distinct tax policy based on the location of the company offering the service.

COURT OF JUSTICE, FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-261/96 Conserchimica: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 2 of Council regulation 1697/79 of July 24, 1979, on the "a posteriori" payment of export duties not requested of the taxable party for goods declared under a customs policy where the payment of such duties is compulsory. Application to cases that occurred before the date when the rule took effect. - Opinion C-307/96 Baldone: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 95a (transitional provision) of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 1248/92 of April 30, 1992. Liquidation of a invalidity pension taking effect after June 1, 1992, but replacing a liquidation that took effect before that date and annulled by the competent institution following the Court order of August 18, 1993, in case C-193/92 Bogana - maintenance of acquired rights.

SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-291/96 Grado. free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 6 and 48. Use of courteous forms of address in a penal procedure.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-151/96 Commission v/ Ireland: free movement of persons. Non-respect. Breach of EC treaty articles 6, 18, 52 and 58 and of article 7 of Commission regulation 1251/71 of June 29, 1970, on workers' rights to reside on a member state's territory after having been employed there and of article 7 of Council directive 75/35/EEC of December 17, 1974, on the rights of member state citizens to reside on the territory of a member state after having held a non salaried activity. Registration of vessels other than fishing vessels. Right to fly the Irish flag. - Oral procedure C-113/96 Gomez Rodriguez: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 48 and 51 and articles 6 and 78 of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 2001/83 of June 2, 1983. Payments for orphans. Definitive nature or otherwise of the determination of the applicable legislation under article 78, paragraph 2(b) of regulation 1408/71. Interpretation of article 6 of said regulation and of EC treaty articles 48 and 51. Criteria permitting the acknowledgement of a more favourable situation for an immigrant worker on the basis of the regulation applicable before the membership of a member state. - (1530/1330 GMT) Oral procedure C-97/96 Daihatsu Deutschland: company law. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 6 of Council directive 68/151/EEC: first council directive of March 9, 1968, on the coordination of safeguards which, for the protection of the interests of members and others, are required by member states of companies within the meaning of the second paragraph of EC treaty article 58, with a view to making such safeguards equivalent throughout the community. Sanctions against companies that do not publish annual accounts. Direct application of the directive. 061145 DED:BC-DIARY-COURT =2 Reuter European Court of Justice Diary (page 2/2)

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-110/95 Yamanouchi Pharmaceutical: approximation of legislation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 3 (b), 8, 9 and 19 of Council regulation 1768/92 of June 18, 1992, on the creation of a complementary protection certificate for medicines. Granting of a complementary protection certificate in a member state other than the one that delivered initial marketing authorisation. - Judgment C-266/95 Merino Garcia: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of annex I, 1.C(a) of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 2001/83 of June 2, 1983. Scope of application of said regulation as regards payments to German families - worker on unpaid vacation. - Judgment C-138/96 Commission v/ Germany: agriculture. Non-respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 92/116/EEC of December 17, 1992, amending and updating Council directive 71/118/EEC on health problems in the fresh meat and poultry trade. - Oral procedure joined cases C-232/95, C-233/95 Commission v/ Greece: environment and consumers. Non-respect. Faulty application of Council directive 76/464/EEC of May 4, 1976, on pollution caused by certain dangerous substances dumped in community waters. Absence of programme to reduce water pollution in lake Vegoritis and the river Soulos and of measures subjecting the dumping of wastes by industries and establishments in the region concerned to prior authorisation. - (1030/0830 GMT) Oral procedure C-68/96 Grundig Italiana: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 95. Tax on audiovisual and photo-optic products. National law specifying different taxable values for national products and comparable imported products. - (1530/1330 GMT) Oral procedure C-66/96 Hoj Pedersen: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 119 and Council directives 75/117/EEC of February 10, 1975, on equal pay for male and female workers and 76/207/EEC of February 9, 1976, on the implementation of the principal of equal treatment for men and women as regards access to jobs, job training and promotion and working conditions. Employer's obligation to maintain pay during absences owing to an illness related to, or worsened by, pregnancy.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, SECOND CHAMBER (enlarged) (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment T-504/93 Tierce Ladbroke v/ Commission: competition. Annulment of Commission decision of June 24, 1993, concerning a complaint in case IV/33.699, Tierce Ladbroke v/ PMU for breach of EC treaty articles 85 and 86. Refusal to deliver to the claimant "picture and sound" retransmission of the finishes of horse races organised in France.

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment joined cases C-65/95, C-111/95 Shingara: free movement of persons. - Judgment C-70/95 Sodemare: free movement of persons. - Oral procedure C-321/95 P Greenpeace Council v/ Commission: regional policy.
FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-105/96 Codiesel: free movement of goods.
FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-164/95 Fabrica de Queijo Eru Portuguesa: free movement of goods.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-360/95 Commission v/ Spain: free movement of persons. - Opinion C-361/95 Commission v/ Spain: free movement of persons. - Opinion C-27/96 Danisco Sugar: membership of new states. - Opinion joined cases C-31/96, C-32/96, C-33/96 Naranjo Arjona: free movement of persons.
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure T-184/95 Dorsch Consult v/ Council and Commission: external relations.
SECOND CHAMBER (enlarged) (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment T-260/94 Air Inter v/ Commission: transport.
THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment T-73/96 Forcat Icardo v/ Commission: status of officials.
